caveats: Per-cell MHW masks restricted to the 92 target days; 3309 of 3600 region cells had finite SST on all target days (sea cells). Day-of-year uses the fixed 366-day calendar (29 Feb=60, 1 Mar=61); day 60 threshold/climatology set to the mean of days 59 and 61 before centred 31-day wraparound smoothing; 90th percentile via numpy method=hazen; +/-5-day windows reach 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05.
